_comment: Example rule file for tools/verify_sot.py. Copy to sot_rules.json (or point JOBSEARCH_SOT_RULES at your own path) and replace these with the claims YOUR ledger actually makes. Four classes: superseded_figures and hard_exclusions fail a document; scale_figures fail only when the line does not attribute the number to the platform; advisory_metrics never fail, they print beside the result. Internal work-item keys are checked without a rule entry: set JOBSEARCH_INTERNAL_KEY_PREFIXES.

superseded_figures.message: the ledger records a different ADR count; 12 is superseded

hard_exclusions.message: do not claim a certification the ledger does not record
work authorization claims need a matching ledger row

scale_figures.message: a six-figure scale needs to be attributed to the platform, not to your own scope

advisory_metrics.message: percentile latency is the kind of number that needs its measurement method attached
